evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The skeptic argued that removing lastmod discards a ranking signal. Resolved on evidence: the emitted value was a single hardcoded 2026-07-19 across all 259 URLs and was already false, since PRs #73, #74 and #75 shipped after it. A demonstrably wrong lastmod is discounted by crawlers; an absent one is read as unknown. No per-item date exists in the content model to substitute.
evidence.winner_rationale: Omitting is the only currently truthful option. Deriving per-URL dates from git at build time was rejected for now because Vercel checkouts are shallow and the content model has no per-item date field; adding real dates to the content is the correct follow-up, and the new test documents that.
